class.name: PHASEManager
class.brief_description: Manages the Apple PHASE spatial audio engine.
class.description: Singleton node that manages the lifecycle of Apple's PHASE spatial audio engine. Automatically added to the scene tree by the GodotPhase editor plugin via [code]PhaseManagerSingleton.gd[/code]. The PHASE engine initializes automatically when this node enters the scene tree. It updates every physics frame while running. Engine-level configuration (such as [code]phase/client_rendering_mode[/code]) is read from [b]Project > Project Settings[/b] at startup. Enable [b]Advanced Settings[/b] in the Project Settings dialog to browse the [code]phase[/code] category. [b]Note:[/b] Only available on Apple platforms (macOS 15.0+, iOS 18.0+, visionOS 26.0+, tvOS 18.0+).

method.name: initialize_engine
method.description: Starts the PHASE audio engine. Called automatically when the node enters the scene tree. Returns [code]true[/code] on success. Manual calls are only needed if the engine was previously shut down with [method shutdown_engine].

method.name: is_client_rendering_active
method.description: [b]visionOS only.[/b] Returns [code]true[/code] if the engine was created with [code]PHASERenderingModeClient[/code]. Reflects the value resolved from [code]phase/client_rendering_mode[/code] when the engine was initialized, so it reports what [constant CLIENT_RENDERING_MODE_AUTOMATIC] actually detected.

method.name: is_engine_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the PHASE engine is currently running.

method.name: shutdown_engine
method.description: Stops the PHASE engine and releases its resources. Also called automatically when this node is freed.

members.member: The reverb preset applied to the scene. Affects all audio sources that have reverb sends enabled. Defaults to [constant REVERB_PRESET_SMALL_ROOM].

constants.constant: [b]visionOS only.[/b] Use [code]PHASERenderingModeClient[/code] if GodotRealityKit is driving the scene, otherwise [code]PHASERenderingModeLocal[/code]. This is the default.
